text:
In 2022, about 0.6 ha of tree cover was lost within this 17.6 ha property, roughly 3.4% of its area. Of that, about 0.5 ha falls on mapped native forest and about 0.1 ha outside mapped forest. None of it was on planted forest.

The evidence is well corroborated. A later year (up to 2025) was observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees across the whole loss area. A further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was detected but isn't counted as an event.

Limits: this is tree-cover loss, not confirmed deforestation or land-use change. The data doesn't show the cause (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), whether it was authorized, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
